payload.reason: The evidence provides clear claims about the computational power of RNNs with arbitrary precision in relation to pushdown automata (PDAs).

claims.text: RNNs with one hidden layer and ReLU activation, when allowed arbitrary precision, are at least as computationally powerful as pushdown automata.
GRUs, when allowed infinite precision and nonlinear output activation functions, are also at least as powerful as pushdown automata.
